PARAMS = {
    "kf":    (1.0, 0.85, 1.15),      # frequency scale (trims finite-GBW shift)
    "qb":    (0.97, 0.75, 1.15),     # SK biquad Q (Butterworth-3 = 1.0)
    "kp":    (1.0, 0.75, 1.35),      # real-pole frequency / fc
    "c2":    (0.3e-12, 0.12e-12, 1.0e-12),  # SK grounded cap
    "c3add": (2.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 6e-12),     # output-pole cap added on top of CL
    "itail": (55e-6, 20e-6, 64e-6),  # OTA tail current
    "gmid_in": (16, 10, 20),         # diff-pair gm/Id
    "L_in":  (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl   = spec.get("cl", 1e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm  = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    vdd  = 1.8

    # ---------------- filter ----------------
    wc = 2 * PI * 1.5e6 * p["kf"]
    Q  = p["qb"]
    C2 = p["c2"]
    C1 = 4 * Q * Q * C2                     # equal-R unity-gain SK: Q = 0.5*sqrt(C1/C2)
    R  = 1.0 / (wc * math.sqrt(C1 * C2))    # w0 = 1/(R*sqrt(C1C2))
    wp = p["kp"] * wc
    Ctot = cl + p["c3add"]
    C3 = p["c3add"]
    R3 = 1.0 / (wp * Ctot)

    # ---------------- OTA (5T, NMOS diff pair) ----------------
    imax = 0.95 * 140e-6 / vdd - iref
    itail = min(p["itail"], imax)
    Lt, gmid_t, Lp = 0.5, 12, 0.5
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], itail / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.12)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_t, Lt, itail, vds=vtail)
    mr = lut.size("n", gmid_t, Lt, iref, vds=mt.vgs)
    mp = lut.size("p", 10, Lp, itail / 2, vds=vdd - vcm)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias mirror
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diff pair: M1 = noninverting (mirror-diode side), M2 = inverting (out side)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "n2", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "oa", "oa", "tail", "vss", m1)   # unity follower feedback
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "oa", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # Sallen-Key unity-gain biquad
    n.R("R1", "vin", "n1", R)
    n.R("R2", "n1", "n2", R)
    n.C("C1", "n1", "oa", C1)
    n.C("C2", "n2", "vss", C2)
    # passive output pole (CL adds to C3)
    n.R("R3", "oa", "vout", R3)
    n.C("C3", "vout", "vss", C3)

    # ---------------- predictions ----------------
    gm = m1.gm
    A0 = gm / (m1.gds + mp.gds)
    cload = C1 + mp.cdd + m1.cdd + mp.cgd
    gbw = gm / (2 * PI * cload)

    f = np.logspace(3, 9, 6000)
    s = 1j * 2 * PI * f
    H = (wc**2 / (s**2 + s * wc / Q + wc**2)) * (1.0 / (1 + s / wp))
    mag = np.abs(H)
    g0 = mag[0]
    idx = np.where(mag < g0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    fc = f[idx[0]] if len(idx) else 1e9
    peaking = db(max(mag.max() / g0, 1.0))
    fs = 10 * fc
    Hs = abs((wc**2 / ((1j*2*PI*fs)**2 + 1j*2*PI*fs*wc/Q + wc**2)) / (1 + 1j*2*PI*fs/wp))
    atten = -db(Hs / g0)
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)

    return n, {"fc": fc, "atten_db": atten, "peaking_db": peaking,
               "gain_db": db(A0 / (1 + A0)), "power": power,
               "gbw_info": gbw, "a0_info": db(A0)}
